metadata.title: बसनिया बांध के विरोध में कानून से लैस आदिवासी | Adivasi is equipped with law to oppose Basania Dam
metadata.description: The proposed Basania Dam in Mandla district of Madhya Pradesh, India has faced opposition from tribal communities in the region. The dam is proposed to be built on the Narmada River and is expected to provide irrigation and drinking water to the surrounding areas. However, the tribals have been protesting against the construction of the dam for several reasons including displacement, ecological impact,  Lack of consultation, and loss of land and livelihoods. Overall, the tribals are concerned about the impact that the Basania Dam will have on their lives and the environment. They feel that the government has not adequately addressed their concerns and has not provided them with adequate compensation for the loss of their land and livelihoods.
